title: Refund of the Remaining Escrow Balance After a Home Mortgage Loans Payoff
content:
After a Home Mortgage Loans note is paid off, the escrow balance remaining on it is refunded to the borrower within the program's stated number of calendar days after the payoff.

## How the days are counted

Calendar days are counted with the day after the payoff date as day 1. The refund is due by the payoff date plus the program's stated number of calendar days. The payoff date is taken from the bank's record of the loan.

## Both sides of the deadline

Take a hypothetical payoff on a program whose refund period is 30 calendar days.

- A refund made on the thirtieth day after the payoff date falls on the day equal to the payoff date plus 30 calendar days. The deadline is a day by which the refund is due, and a refund made on that day is within it.
- A refund made on the thirty-first day after the payoff date falls past the payoff date plus 30 calendar days, and the deadline has passed.

## Basis of judgement

| Element | Basis |
|---|---|
| Event the clock starts from | The payoff |
| Verifiable record | The loan's recorded payoff date |
| Counting | Calendar days, the day after the payoff date being day 1 |
| Direction of the comparison | The refund is made not later than the payoff date plus the period |
| The boundary day itself | Within the deadline |
| Amount refunded | The escrow balance remaining on the loan after payoff |
